name: The Powder Keg Ledger
summary: Weston Murdoch keeps a ledger of who the hysteria will take, and he wants to cross names off before the seventh dawn.

stages.journal: Weston Murdoch showed us his ledger: on the seventh dawn of the charm a neighbour dies and a house burns, and the toll doubles every week after. He has names for the first two weeks.
stages.hint: Protect who you can: hide Jeremiah Stover at the estate, and wet the schoolhouse roof before the seventh dawn.

stages.journal: The ledger has a name crossed out. The village still burned, but not as much.
The charm broke before the seventh dawn, and the ledger was never needed. Weston closed it, and wept a little.
The seventh dawn came, and the ledger's first names were not crossed out.
